tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add Table.query_page(cond=None, *, limit=100, after=None) returning (documents,next_cursor). Integer document IDs are sorted ascending, after is exclusive, condition is optional and evaluated on detached Documents. Return at most limit rows; next_cursor is the last returned matching ID only if another match exists, otherwise None. Support sparse IDs, insert/remove between pages, MemoryStorage and JSONStorage. Deep-copy returned data so caller or predicate changes cannot mutate storage. Validate limit 1..1000 and nonnegative integer cursor, excluding booleans. This is keyset pagination, without snapshot/concurrent-writer guarantees.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_td_page_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-td-page-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add tinydb.operations.set_path(path,value,*,create=False) and delete_path(path,*,missing_ok=False), returning ordinary Table.update callbacks. Paths are finite nonempty string-key sequences with literal punctuation. Set deep-copies the supplied value when building the operation and separately per document; optionally create missing mapping parents. Delete preserves siblings and optionally tolerates missing keys. Nonmapping parents remain errors. Validate a complete candidate document before replacing that document contents so a failed callback leaves it unchanged; do not promise a transaction across all documents or modify old operations.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_td_nested_update_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-td-nested-update-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

tasks.goal: 提供序列化失败不损坏旧文件的原子JSON存储
tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement tinydb.atomic.AtomicJSONStorage(Storage) with TinyDB-compatible read/write/close and constructor (path, *, create_dirs=False, encoding="utf-8", **json_options). Serialize completely before opening a same-directory temporary file, flush/fsync and atomically os.replace; preserve existing mode, use 0600 for new files, clean temporary files and retain old bytes on serialization/write/replace failure. Read current path each time, return None for absent/empty files, reject nonmapping JSON roots and symlink targets, and reject reads/writes after close. Verify reopen and shrinking data. Preserve existing JSONStorage and do not claim cross-process locking, hostile-directory race protection or parent-directory crash durability.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_td_atomic_storage_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-td-atomic-storage-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.
